required_assets: Original continuous talking-head video with clear voice audio
optional_assets: Separate microphone recording, with a visible clap for synchronization if convenient
Relevant screen capture at original resolution
Preferred-take note or approximate mistake timestamps
recording.camera: Eye-level, head-and-shoulders framing, clean background, front-facing light
recording.voice: Clear dry speech; no baked-in music; no clipping
recording.mistakes: Pause 2–3 seconds, restart the full sentence, and continue recording

timeline.timing_basis: Provisional edited-program positions; align source cuts to actual narration
timeline.source_in_out_points: Unset until the recording is reviewed

scenes.title: The compiler transformations we built
cues: Open on the presenter, then the title. Point to reuse, parallel work, and tensor pipelines.
Show the title and the three contribution families: reuse data, redistribute work, and build tensor pipelines. Keep scheduled Emmy IR and RTX 5090 visible.

scenes.title: Where our passes run
cues: Follow the pipeline. Say the LLVM credit clearly.

Show input validation, the actual early rewrite order, specialized lowering, and LLVM/NVPTX. The early order is vectorization, register forwarding, recurrence reordering, then grid folding. Name the project contribution: recognizers, guards, and transformed GPU schedules.

scenes.title: Reuse data before loading it again
cues: Trace the retained vector through reduction and consumer.

Show scalar loop to four values per lane; then load vector, reduce, and reuse the same vector in a consumer. Highlight matching indices, readonly input, closed lifetimes, and aligned complete coverage.

scenes.title: Reshape parallel work
cues: Show lane cooperation, then folded K work and inactive surplus blocks.

Use two concrete illustrations: repeated dot to lane partials plus shuffle, and four eligible split-K partitions folded into two logical partitions with twice the K work. Label the factor-two drawing illustrative; the actual factor is guarded. Surplus physical CTAs exit; the original atomic output remains. The four partitions are per output tile within a larger grid; sufficient total parallelism remains a guard.

scenes.title: Turn contractions into tensor work
cues: Explain the three products. Keep the FP16 strip separate from tensor operands.

Show a shared-memory contraction becoming warp MMA, with high/high, high/low, and low/high products. Label low/low omitted, FP32 buffers and accumulation, and ordinary FP32 mode available. Show a separate FP16 storage to FP32 arithmetic to nearest-even FP16 store strip.

scenes.title: Rewrite the pipeline feeding tensor cores
cues: Compare the two paths. The packed BF16 path replaces the asynchronous ring.

Compare the scheduled FP32 asynchronous copy ring with the certified packed BF16 rewrite: register prefetch, producer packing, shared layout, and fragment lookahead. Keep the exact copy-phase guard visible. Show final unused prefetch/consumer barrier omitted while producer synchronization remains. TF32x3 and FP32 retain the eligible cp.async path.

scenes.title: Recognize and stage the attention recurrence
cues: Follow scores to weights to mass and PV. Then show guarded storage reuse.

Show repeated score and online max/mass/value work becoming score reuse, row maximum, shared unnormalized weights, and separate mass/PV accumulation. Show two/four adjacent key rounds and read-to-maximum-to-store lifetime ordering in the same warp and component. Each unnormalized weight feeds register mass accumulation directly and shared storage for PV; mass does not reread shared weights.

scenes.title: Redistribute probability–value work
cues: Trace four key shards into the first eight writing lanes.

Draw four eight-lane groups, each processing a key shard and four adjacent columns per lane. Combine groups with butterfly offsets 16 and 8; only the first eight lanes write. Show restoring the saved denominator before each closed per-column suffix replay.

scenes.title: Measure the whole compiler on RTX 5090
cues: Slow for the ratios. Hold the results slide silently from 2:55 to 3:00.

Show the recorded warm latency bars: Deuteron 3.752 microseconds, NVCC 6.216, tested Triton 4.332. Show 1.66x and 1.15x, 15 open workloads, 270 balanced calls, 20 warmups/200 iterations, original output checks, and compile/assembly/transport excluded. Hold this slide unchanged for the last five seconds.

duration_policy.overrun_action: Use a shorter spoken pickup or revise the cut; never force the target by cutting words

picture_plan.default_transition: Clean cut at a spoken phrase boundary

optional_crossfade.duration_accounting: Overlap inside the planned timeline; do not add runtime

picture_plan.motion: Restrained reveals and highlights; no continuous zooming or decorative effects

presenter.overlay_rule: Use only empty slide space; omit the inset if it covers content or captions

picture_plan.demo_policy: The narrated edit uses nine slides and no standalone terminal demo. The three pass-reference slides and archived compile demonstration stay outside the three-minute timeline.

captioned_slide_layout.rule: Scale the full slide uniformly into this presentation area; reserve the bottom band for captions and preserve every slide footnote. Check two-line captions fit the band.

picture_plan.clean_slide_layout: Use the native full-screen 1920×1080 slide; presenter inset only in unobstructed space.

audio_plan.processing: Correct sync, edit mistakes, and apply light cleanup only as needed for intelligibility

music.rights_policy: Original or properly licensed for the intended distribution
provenance_required: Source URL or original creation record
music.ducking_amount: Adjust to the actual voice and music so every word remains clear
music.fade_timing: Set after the narration edit; finish the fade by 175 seconds

initial_mix_targets.status: Starting targets, not measured results or guaranteed final settings
initial_mix_targets.verification: Listen for intelligibility and measure the final encoded export; adjust as needed

captions_policy.alignment: Realign to edited audio after picture and narration cuts settle
captions_policy.manual_review: Check technical names, numbers, punctuation, and every caption boundary
captions_policy.layout: Readable text in safe margins, normally no more than two lines
captions_policy.captioned_master: Burn in the reviewed aligned captions

export_targets.final_review: Check timing, voice clarity, slide readability, caption sync, and the complete silent end hold
